title: मधमाशी पालन व मध निर्मिती: परागीकरणापासून ब्रँडेड विक्रीपर्यंत
creator: Rajani Gairshail
description: The photograph captures the beekeeping practices of Himachal Pradesh. Traditionally, beekeeping has remained an integral part of household life in the region. Almost every house used to have wooden containers specially made for keeping bees. Being from Himachal Pradesh, I remember that when I was growing up, not very long ago, there was hardly a single house in my village without these wooden bee containers. I also observed that in almost every household there was at least one person, irrespective of gender, who was skilled in extracting honey from them. Such practices represent the traditional food culture and rural lifestyle of Himachal Pradesh, reflecting the close relationship between the people and their natural environment.
